Northbridge Logistics — discovery call notes
Call date: 20 Aug 2026
Attendees: Priya Nandakumar (Ops Lead), Marcus Webb (Koya Talent)

Current state
- Dispatch runs out of a shared Google Sheet, edited by up to 4 people at once.
- Roughly 40 dispatch events happen on a typical weekday.
- Their fleet-tracking vendor (FleetPulse) exposes a GPS ping every 30 seconds
  per vehicle via a REST API already in use by their existing ops tooling.
- Double-booking (two dispatchers assigning the same driver) happens 3-4
  times a week and is their single biggest complaint.

What they explicitly ruled out
- Replacing FleetPulse itself — they are contracted through 2027 and are
  happy with the hardware.
- A native mobile app for drivers on day one — they want web-only first and
  will revisit mobile after the pilot.

Depot detail
- 6 depots total. The pilot should run at their Manchester depot first
  (18 drivers), since it has the most consistent GPS coverage.

Quote from Priya: "If a dispatcher could just see who's free and closest,
this whole problem goes away."
